_comment: Results screen lines (scripts/payoff.gd): when a mission writes no line of its own in result['changed'], someone who went says one of these about what changed. Keys per hero: people (folk walked into town), person (someone joined), place (a province inked back in), lost (retreat or driven out), plain (a job with no big change). A line may be {who, text} when someone else answers for them (Tally). Ash is silent and has none. Voices: docs/VOICES.md.

people: Count 'em in, smudge. Nine, ten... nobody's payin' for this lot. Goin' on the bill anyway.
Look at 'em. Walkin' in like they owe us. They don't. Yet.
place: White's backed off. Don't mean it's sorry. Means it's 'ungry somewhere else.
person: Another mouth, another bunk. Goin' on the bill, smudge.
lost: Clause two: we walk away breathin'. Says nothin' about walkin' away proud.
plain: Job done. Hazard pay's on the bill. You can read it if you like. I can't.

people: Thin, they are. Feed them first, dearie, then I'll see to the coughs. The coughs pay better.
place: Colour's coming back to it, look. Like a cheek after a slap. Lovely, that is.
person: New face, is it. I'll open an account. First visit's free. The second one isn't.
lost: We'll not talk about it now. Sit down. The bruises go on your account, no interest. Once.
plain: Nobody dead and only a little bleeding. I'll call that a good day, I will.

people: Counted them through. All present. First list I ever carried that came back longer.
place: Line held. Mark it on the map before some sir in a hat takes the credit.
person: New recruit. Kit's thin, boots are worse. They'll do.
lost: Fell back. Orderly. Not on record as a rout. Not on any record, if anyone asks.

people: Look at 'em, trailin' into town after you like ducks. Somebody'll want a speech, cully. Not from you, obviously.
place: It's got its colour back. Prettier than before, if the sun's not foolin' me again.
person: Another face for Hollowmark. I'll show 'em the good roof for sittin' on. Not my roof.
lost: We'll go back after dark. Everythin' goes better after dark.
plain: Clean job. Nobody peached, nobody bled much. I'm nearly bored.

people: I have entered them by name. Every one. The Concord never bothered with the names.
place: The province returns to the ledger. In black ink, I should think. For once.
person: A new account opened. I shall need their particulars, and they will need a coat.
lost: Enter it as a loss. In red. One does not tidy the record because it is unpleasant.
plain: The sums balance. I shall pretend that does not please me.

people: Counted 'em out of there. Counted 'em in here. Same number. That's the job.
place: Aye. Looks like a place again. Give it a week, it'll look like somewhere.
person: New one. Name's on the list. Not the short list.
lost: Door's shut on that one today. We go back when it opens.
plain: Job done. Nowt broken. Us included.

people: Look at them, chérie. An audience, walking home. Nobody walks home from my shows.
place: Voilà. The colour comes back like a blush. The Blank, it hates an encore.
person: A new face for the company. I shall teach them where to stand. And where not to.
lost: Enfin. Sometimes the curtain comes down early, darling. We bow anyway.
plain: A clean performance. No blood on the costume. Almost a disappointment.

people: Shall I send them invitations, sweet? No. They have walked far enough. Bread will do.
place: There. The colour is back where it belongs. One could almost give a party in it.
person: Someone new. I shall know everything about them by Thursday. Politely.
lost: We stepped out for air. It happens in the best families.
plain: Done, and nobody wore the wrong thing. A rare afternoon.

people: That's a verse, love. Folk walkin' home with somewhere to walk to. I'll find the tune later.
place: Colour's back. Sounds different an' all. Higher, like.
person: Somebody new. Another song with no last verse yet.
lost: Tomorrow, love. We'll start this one again from the top.
plain: Done an' dusted. Gin's on me. Well. Gin's on you.

people: Saved the lot of 'em, sunshine. Single-'anded. Tell 'em it was me.

people.text: She stood at the back. The people walked in by themselves.

place: Look at that, colour's back. I'll tell the Guild it cost twice as much.
person: New mark. Recruit, I mean. I said recruit.

lost.text: We ran. She will tell you we regrouped.

plain: Easy as a church collection, that.

people: They walk in the right way round. Ilse counted. Nobody came back reversed.
place: The colour is back on the right side. Ilse approves.
person: Someone new. Ilse will learn their face. She is good at faces.
lost: Ilse has checked the mirror. Her face is fine. The day was not.
plain: Done, and neatly. Nearly as neatly as she would have done it.
